title: A fix check may end on a merge of two lane commits that the verifier read
why: Owner chat 00:14 CST Nov 19 asked whether the merge tool's refusal of the PR 3694 record ("the head is a merge of a lane commit") is valid or a fixed bug. Triage read by REST: head 02736c944a of PR 3694 is a two-parent merge of two lane commits (d13b244d53, a32b081ff7), not main, so the carve-out for a clean merge of main (steps carry-forgives-main-merge, grant-line-clean-merge-no-verifier) does not cover it. Owner typed "approved" at 00:16 CST on the consultant's offer to fix it (relayed by the consultant).
source: consultant's offer; owner's word "approved" 00:16 CST Nov 19, relayed by the consultant; triage 12
note: Todo. Builder lane after the merge queue clears (the consultant's plan, his words).
